about: Scott F. Templeton attended law school and graduated from University of San Diego School of Law in 2006. Scott Templeton began practicing law in 2006.

Scott Templeton is an attorney at San Diego Elder Law Center, helping people with Estate Planning & Probate issues. San Diego Elder Law Center has an office in San Diego, California, serving the local community.

Scott Templeton was selected to Super Lawyers for 2025 - 2026. Super Lawyers is an exclusive list of top-rated attorneys in specific practice areas who were chosen after thorough evaluation of numerous criteria.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
